# Accessories

# Introduction

Accessories are items that can equipped. They share the same equipment slot, only one accessory can be equipped at a time.

## List of accessories

• Name: Megingjord | Source: Haldor | Cost: 950 Coins | Effects: +150.0 carry weight

• Name: Wishbone | Source: Bonemass | Effects: Reveals nearby secrets, notably Silver veins

• Name: Wisplight | Source: Workbench | Cost: 1 Silver 1 Wisp | Effects: Clears the mist in the Mistlands
